context_varying_parameters.reason: Source strata require one internally encoded sex; the target mixture is unspecified and is explicitly chosen to be balanced between literal codes.

context_varying_parameters.name: sex_profiles
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source BMI/TC/HDL geometric means and strict low-HDL prevalences differ by published stratum. Source profiles use one raw anchor; the target pools three sex-corresponding anchors with explicitly equal assumed transport weights. HDL dispersion and pooled log moments are finite inline derivations under a chosen distribution family.

context_varying_parameters.name: extra_log_error_sd
context_varying_parameters.reason: Source anchors already describe source recorded values. The target protocol differs, so a modest extra independent log dispersion is explicitly assumed for measured TC and HDL without claiming assay or fasting equivalence or identifying true protocol error.
